excerpt: Understand Ajman apartment service charges, the documents to request and how recurring building costs affect an owner's budget and rental yield.
introduction:
Apartment service charges fund shared parts of a building or development. For an Ajman buyer or landlord, the actual annual amount can change the affordability of the property and the net income left after rent. Ask for the current charge and supporting documents for the exact unit before committing.

The applicable rules and calculation can depend on the project and its approved arrangements. This guide explains what to ask and shows how building charges affect an owner’s budget.
takeaways: Ask for the unit's current charge, payment schedule, arrears and approved budget rather than relying on an area average.
The relevant Ajman owners' affairs law describes an owner's share of common-area costs for developments within its scope.
Include owner-paid service charges in annual costs and net rental yield, without counting them twice.

sections.heading: What are service charges?
sections.body:
Service charges can cover the management, operation, maintenance and repair of common areas and facilities. Depending on the approved budget and the project, these may include shared lighting, cleaning, lifts, security or landscaped areas. The particular services and amount should be checked in the building's documents.

Article 25 of Ajman's [2020 owners' affairs law](https://ajmanre.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/English-%D9%82%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%85-3-%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%86%D8%A9-2020-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D8%A3%D9%86-%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%B8%D9%8A%D9%85-%D8%B4%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%83-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86.pdf) describes an owner's specified share of common-area expenses and an annual budget approved by the department. The law states its scope includes real estate development areas, including free zones. Confirm its current application and any subsequent decisions for the particular project with the authority.

A service charge is different from the apartment's own electricity or water bill and from a property manager's fee for finding a tenant. Ask which bill covers each service so the same expense is not counted twice.

sections.heading: How is the unit's share determined?
sections.body:
The 2020 law describes a specified owner share based on the common space attributable to the unit, while preserving a department-established mechanism for common areas approved before the law. It also refers to the approved annual budget and the contribution of each unit. Ask management and the department how the current calculation applies to your property; do not substitute a generic per-square-foot figure.

Request the unit plan, charge statement and supporting budget. Check the period covered, the payment dates, whether a reserve is included and whether there are other approved amounts. A small unit in one building can have a different charge from a similarly sized unit elsewhere because facilities, contracts and allocation methods differ.

Ask for the history of charges and any known major works. Past payments provide context but do not guarantee the future budget.

sections.heading: See the effect on a rental calculation
sections.body:
Suppose an apartment has AED 48,000 of annual rent, an AED 4,000 vacancy allowance, AED 7,000 of owner-paid service charges and AED 6,000 of other operating costs. Net operating income is AED 31,000. On an assumed total acquisition cost of AED 620,000, that is 5% before financing, tax and eventual sale costs. These example inputs show how the annual building charge changes the amount left to the owner.

If the same example's service charge increases to AED 9,000 and everything else stays unchanged, net income is AED 29,000 and the yield is approximately 4.68%. The chart compares those two scenarios. Real rent, vacancy and other expenses may change as well.

The [Ajman net rental yield guide](/journal/how-to-calculate-net-rental-yield-in-ajman) explains the full formula. Do not include a charge as an owner expense if it is already accounted for elsewhere in the same calculation.

sections.heading: Check arrears before transfer
sections.body:
Ask for a current statement and written confirmation of outstanding charges for the exact unit. The owners' affairs law addresses amounts due before disposal, while Ajman's [sale registration service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3162) lists a developer clearance for real estate units. Confirm the applicable clearance and settlement process with the department and the relevant management.

Agree in writing how charges relating to the period before and after transfer will be settled. Check that payment evidence and clearance identify the right unit. A seller's verbal assurance is not a substitute for a current statement.

If the property is tenanted, review the lease and ask a qualified adviser about the responsibilities that apply. Do not assume a landlord can change the tenant's obligations simply because building charges increase.

sections.heading: Plan for future costs and questions
sections.body:
Service charges can change with an approved budget and the needs of the building. Ask how owners receive budgets, statements and notices, and who handles complaints about common-area maintenance. The law describes management obligations and an owners' committee for developments within its scope; check the arrangements for your project.

Maintain a separate reserve for work inside the apartment and periods without rent. A building service charge is not a guarantee that every repair inside a unit or every future cost is included. Ask for the scope of cover and any insurance details in writing.

For a new development, request the estimated charge and basis of calculation, and ask when a final approved budget will be available. An estimate should not be treated as a fixed lifetime cost.

sections.heading: Compare current projects
sections.body:
Read the [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026), browse the [Aliyas Ajman project collection](/projects?emirate=Ajman) and request current unit-specific information. Compare charges against the same period and services for each property, and keep copies of the statements for reference.

[Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your intended budget and whether you plan to live in or let the apartment. Obtain written statements and verify the legal and financial position with the relevant authority before committing.
